answer: Proof of unique photography EXIF trail turns identity into something scarce. Because photos with a camera serial and GPS trail over years, the lagoon of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the ripple is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the pigment is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke. Open to one real agent, closed to a thousand fakes — that is the whole design.
